hypothesis: Keeping the image of a retrieved historical training example can improve new-case decisions beyond the identical text-only example, unchanged H0 and a source-image mismatch control. External episodic memory is the learned state; no weight or tool updates.

selection.training: All original 24 A training cases from v9, reusing v10 source_training; retain both benchmark-correct and discordant source attempts. No new generation or expert-validity claim.
selection.development: Reuse the exact 24 v10 development cases and order. Their results/labels have been exposed in development; this is an adaptive development experiment, not fresh confirmation.
selection.source_retrieval: Question-only Jaccard after fixed token removal, rank then frozen memory ID; always select exactly one of the 24 training examples. No target labels, previous outcome or manual choice in retrieval.
selection.mismatch: Replace the selected historical image with the next source image cyclically in the frozen 24-source bank; keep selected question/attempt/target text unchanged. Never use a development or confirmation image as historical support.

memory.representation: Historical question, semantic attempted answer and unadjudicated target text, with original source image only in image arms. Stored source labels are training feedback, not current-case gold.
memory.source_risk: Known source-supervision uncertainty is retained and explicitly warned in every historical prompt. Do not make clinical validity claims or infer that benchmark targets are medical truth.

execution.order: Case-wise rotation of all four arms, second block reversed case order with rotation shifted by one. Fresh Agent/MemorySaver per physical run, no aliases.
execution.images: One current-case image in every arm. Exactly one extra historical image in image/mismatch. Current image first; support image second. Image/mismatch prompts have identical text.
execution.tool_boundary: All six unchanged author tools may inspect ONLY the current-case images. Historical-image requests fail normal validation and remain in recorded cost/failure counts. No new visual tool or baseline tuning.
execution.scoring: Original two-turn exact final-letter scoring. Evaluator sidecar read by worker only after all predictions or termination. No in-run source/parameter/threshold edits.
execution.controller: gpt-6.1-sol/high through existing local subscription bridge, no API key or Astra.

gate.requirements: All 192 episodes valid. In BOTH repeats image arm net gain >=2/24 vs H0 with H0 losses <=1; net gain >=1/24 vs text and >=1/24 vs mismatch; >=2 cases H0 wrong/image correct in both repeats.
gate.interpretation: Exploratory development gate only. A positive gap vs mismatch alone may reflect mismatch harm; require positive gain vs unchanged H0 and text too. No B learning or retention claim.
gate.pass: Freeze a subsequent B-learning/retention protocol using actual learned A state before touching the 96-case confirmation reserve.
gate.fail: Close this fixed hypothesis/variant. No source resampling, extra generations, threshold relaxation, new A cases or follow-up prompt tweaks inside the run.
gate.statistics: Full paired tables per repeat, exact descriptive McNemar, acquired/lost subsets, current-case tool failures from historical-image misuse, context/image-token cost. Repeated cases do not increase independent N.

limitations: Adaptive reuse of v10 development after observing its failure; not independent confirmation.
One source bank, one fixed retrieval rule, limited 24-case development, no clinical adjudication.
Image vs text includes extra image-token and latency cost; mismatch controls image count but is a deliberately mismatched experimental input, never clinical use.
No claim that HCL generally fails or succeeds from one variant.
Only A acquisition; no sequential B update until a qualifying A signal.
public_boundary: Only source/protocol/aggregate/cost; no source questions, images, answers, private identifiers, memory records or per-case outputs.
